The Truth About Expiring QR Codes

Why Do Other QR Codes Stop Working After 14 Days?

In cities like Chicago and New York, hundreds of businesses get trapped printing business cards and restaurant menus only for them to deactivate. Here is the technical difference between commercial traps and Strix QR.

✕ Most Online QR Generators (The Subscription Trap)
  • ✕Sneaky Middleman Redirect: Instead of encoding your URL, they encode their private link (qr.co/xyz123).
  • ✕14-Day Expiration: When the free trial ends, their server turns off the redirect and replaces your website with a paywall.
  • ✕Held Hostage for $35/Month: If you already printed 1,000 menus or business cards, you are forced to pay or throw your prints away.
  • ✕Requires Credit Card & Account: Demands personal information before letting you download.
✓ Strix QR by StrixDevs (Permanent Direct Engine)
  • ✓Direct Static Encoding: Your actual URL or WiFi password is baked directly into the black and white pattern with no middleman server.
  • ✓Works Forever Guaranteed: Permanent lifetime encoding. Even if our website were ever offline, your printed QR codes still work!
  • ✓Print-Ready Vector SVG & PDF: Scalable without pixelation for billboards, store window decals, and vehicle wraps.
  • ✓Ephemeral Codes Supported: Optional One-Time self-destructing codes for secure single-use coupons and Wi-Fi access.
